1|"""Cloud safety box for FreeCAD answers (SPEC section 1).
2|
3|Why this file exists (user decision 2026-10-29): nothing Glimmer writes
4|may run on the Mac. Every answer runs in a fresh Modal Sandbox
5|(block_network=True, no secrets, no volumes, cpu 1, memory 1024-4096
6|MiB, 90 s box); one sandbox per answer, terminated after use.
7|
8|Image: FreeCAD 1.1.4 for Linux from the official release asset
9|``FreeCAD_1.1.4-Linux-x86_64-py311.AppImage`` (GitHub release
10|2026-09-28): downloaded in the image build, SHA256-verified against the
11|release's SHA256 file, unpacked with ``--appimage-extract`` (no FUSE
12|needed). The build prints ``freecadcmd`` version 1.1.4 (the Mac manual's
13|version). No conda route: conda-forge has no 1.1.4 build (1.1.0, 1.1.3,
14|2026.09.16 only); a different FreeCAD version could change the result.
15|The image holds ONLY FreeCAD + run_one_fc.py: no references, no jobs
16|file, no expected.json, no cadquery (see IMAGE_FILES).
17|
18|Flow: write answer.py with sb.filesystem.write_text, run
19|``freecadcmd /work/run_one_fc.py`` with sb.exec (env FC_SCRATCH=/work,
20|timeout 60 s inside the 90 s box, the baseline's speed limit), read back
21|/work/answer.step (bytes) + /work/measure.json, then sb.terminate().
22|STEP answers over 20 MB are refused. The verdict and failure tags come
23|only from the grader; measure.json is for logs (the box runs untrusted
24|code and must not score itself).
25|
26|Modal is imported lazily so the config helpers (sandbox kwargs, image
27|file list) are unit-testable offline. Tests inject a fake sandbox; any
28|test that could reach a real Modal call monkeypatches it to raise.
29|"""
30|
31|import os
32|
33|FREECAD_VERSION = "1.1.4"
34|APPIMAGE_ASSET = "FreeCAD_1.1.4-Linux-x86_64-py311.AppImage"
35|APPIMAGE_URL = (
36|    "https://github.com/FreeCAD/FreeCAD/releases/download/1.1.4/"
37|    + APPIMAGE_ASSET
38|)
39|APPIMAGE_SHA_NAME = APPIMAGE_ASSET + "-SHA256.txt"
40|APPIMAGE_SHA_URL = (
41|    "https://github.com/FreeCAD/FreeCAD/releases/download/1.1.4/"
42|    + APPIMAGE_SHA_NAME
43|)
44|
45|CPU = 1
46|MEMORY_MIB = (1024, 4096)
47|SANDBOX_TIMEOUT_S = 90  # the box: one sandbox per answer
48|EXEC_TIMEOUT_S = 60  # the answer run inside it (the baseline's limit)
49|MAX_STEP_BYTES = 20 * 1024 * 1024  # STEP answers over 20 MB are refused
50|
51|WORK_DIR = "/work"
52|ANSWER_NAME = "answer.py"
53|RUN_SCRIPT = "run_one_fc.py"  # experiments/freecad/run_one_fc.py, baked in
54|STEP_PATH = WORK_DIR + "/answer.step"
55|MEASURE_PATH = WORK_DIR + "/measure.json"
56|
57|# The box image holds ONLY FreeCAD + run_one_fc.py.
58|IMAGE_FILES = [RUN_SCRIPT]
59|
60|try:
61|    import modal
62|except ImportError:  # offline: config helpers still work; runs refuse
63|    modal = None
64|
65|
66|def sandbox_kwargs():
67|    """Keyword args for modal.Sandbox.create: no network, no secrets,
68|    no volumes, one cpu, 1-4 GiB, 90 s. No "secrets"/"volumes" keys."""
69|    return {
70|        "block_network": True,
71|        "cpu": CPU,
72|        "memory": MEMORY_MIB,
73|        "timeout": SANDBOX_TIMEOUT_S,
74|    }
75|
76|
77|def image_files():
78|    """Files baked into the box image besides FreeCAD itself."""
79|    return list(IMAGE_FILES)
80|
81|
82|EXEC_APP_NAME = "forge-freecad"  # Modal app the boxes run under
83|
84|
85|def lookup_exec_app():
86|    """The Modal app handle for boxes (created on first lookup)."""
87|    if modal is None:
88|        raise RuntimeError("modal is not installed; cannot look up the app")
89|    return modal.App.lookup(EXEC_APP_NAME, create_if_missing=True)
90|
91|
92|def build_image():
93|    """Modal image: download the AppImage, verify SHA256, unpack with
94|    --appimage-extract, link freecadcmd on PATH, and print `freecadcmd`
95|    version 1.1.4. Lazy: no network or Modal call until the image builds
96|    remotely. `curl -fL` fails the build on an HTTP error (a 404 is not a
97|    checksum mismatch later)."""
98|    if modal is None:
99|        raise RuntimeError("modal is not installed; cannot build the box image")
100|    return (
101|        modal.Image.from_registry("debian:bookworm-slim")
102|        .run_commands(
103|            "apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends "
104|            "ca-certificates curl libgl1 libglib2.0-0 libx11-6 libxext6 "
105|            "libxrender1 libsm6 libice6",
106|        )
107|        .run_commands(
108|            "curl -fL -o /opt/%s %s" % (APPIMAGE_ASSET, APPIMAGE_URL),
109|            "curl -fL -o /opt/%s %s" % (APPIMAGE_SHA_NAME, APPIMAGE_SHA_URL),
110|            "cd /opt && grep %s %s | sha256sum -c -"

40|    run CadQuery, so an answer could dodge the tool being tested)."""

43|        self.refused = tuple(refused)

46|        if (name or "").split(".")[0] in self.refused:
47|            return self

77|def run_answer_source(source):

81|    on a clean exec, else a short "Type: message" string. A missing

548|def gpu_elapsed_s(t_start_mono, gpu_start):
549|    """GPU seconds for the money estimate: since the session's GPU start
550|    when given (the whole-session cap covers deploy + ready waits), else
551|    the runner's own wall clock."""
552|    if gpu_start is None:
553|        return time.monotonic() - t_start_mono
554|    try:
555|        return max(0.0, time.time() - float(gpu_start))
556|    except (TypeError, ValueError):
557|        return time.monotonic() - t_start_mono

590|                 exec_fn=None, grade_fn=None, w_job_ids=None,
591|                 call_timeout=CALL_TIMEOUT, affinity=None, gpu_start=None):
592|    """Call every (job, arm) pair `k` times with `workers` threads.
593|
594|    Arms run one after another with that many workers (up to 8 sandboxes
595|    in parallel), never mixed. New calls stop once the cost estimate
596|    passes `budget`; new S calls stop at `budget_c`, new W calls at
597|    `budget_w`. W runs only on `w_job_ids` (S's failed jobs). Writes
598|    calls.jsonl, summary.json and report.md into `out_dir`.

602|    affinity = affinity or uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]

607|    os.makedirs(out_dir, exist_ok=True)
608|    pool_size = workers or MAX_WORKERS
609|    t_start = time.monotonic()
610|    s_usages, w_usages = [], []
611|    budget_stopped = budget_c_stopped = budget_w_stopped = False
612|    records = []
613|    arm_timing = {}
614|    for arm in arms:
615|        if arm == "W":

617|        else:
618|            arm_jobs = list(jobs)
619|        pairs = [(job, rep) for job in arm_jobs for rep in range(k)]
620|        arm_start = runner.utcnow_iso()
621|        arm_t0 = time.monotonic()
622|        arm_recs = [None] * len(pairs)
623|        next_i, in_flight = 0, {}
624|        with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(

626|            while next_i < len(pairs) or in_flight:

628|                    if over_budget_fc(s_usages, w_usages,

633|                    if arm == "S" and runner.over_budget_c(s_usages, budget_c):
634|                        budget_c_stopped = True
635|                        next_i += 1
636|                        continue

638|                        budget_w_stopped = True

646|                        sleep_fn, exec_fn, grade_fn, call_timeout, affinity)
647|                    in_flight[fut] = next_i
648|                    next_i += 1

651|                if not in_flight:

+    assert seen[b"STEP:result = 2"] == "M1"
+    assert lines[-1] == "HAND FAIL"  # M6/M10/H6/H13 missing: no HAND OK
+    out = capsys.readouterr().out
+    assert "M1: PASS" in out and "M1_wrong: FAIL" in out
+    assert "HAND FAIL" in out
+
+
+def _hand_files(tmp_path, names):
+    paths = []
+    for n in names:
+        p = tmp_path / (n + ".py")
+        p.write_text("result = %s" % n, encoding="utf-8")
+        paths.append(str(p))
+    return paths
+
+
+def _hand_fakes(exact=True, wrong_verdict="FAIL", diff_ok=True):
+    """exec/grade fakes for the 7 hand stems; grade under mapped job ids."""
+
+    def fake_exec(source):
+        return {"step_bytes": ("STEP:" + source).encode(), "measure": {},
+                "log": "", "run_error": None}
+
+    def fake_grade(job_id, step):
+        stem = step.decode().split("result = ", 1)[1]
+        base = {"bbox": [0, 0, 0, 10, 5, 2], "volume": 100.0}
+        if stem in ("M1_wrong", "H13_wrong"):
+            meas = dict(base) if diff_ok else {
+                "bbox": [0, 0, 0, 10, 5, 3], "volume": 150.0}
+            return {"verdict": wrong_verdict, "tight": wrong_verdict,
+                    "fails": [] if wrong_verdict == "PASS" else ["bbox"],
+                    "measurements": meas}
+        meas = dict(base) if exact else {
+            "bbox": [0, 0, 0, 10, 5, 3], "volume": 150.0}
+        return {"verdict": "PASS", "tight": "PASS", "fails": [],
+                "measurements": meas}
+
+    expected = {n: {"bbox": [0, 0, 0, 10, 5, 2], "volume": 100.0}
+                for n in ("M1", "M6", "M10", "H6", "H13", "M1_wrong",
+                          "H13_wrong")}
+    return fake_exec, fake_grade, expected
+
+
+def test_check_hand_ok_gate(tmp_path, capsys):
+    names = ["M1", "M6", "M10", "H6", "H13", "M1_wrong", "H13_wrong"]
+    exec_fn, grade_fn, expected = _hand_fakes()
+    lines = cloud_exec.check_hand(_hand_files(tmp_path, names),
+                                  exec_fn=exec_fn, grade_fn=grade_fn,
+                                  expected=expected)
+    assert lines[-1] == "HAND OK"
+    assert "HAND OK" in capsys.readouterr().out
+
+
+def test_check_hand_gate_rejects_wrong_pass_and_big_diff(tmp_path):
+    names = ["M1", "M6", "M10", "H6", "H13", "M1_wrong", "H13_wrong"]
+    # A wrong answer that PASSes is not HAND OK.
+    exec_fn, grade_fn, expected = _hand_fakes(wrong_verdict="PASS")
+    assert cloud_exec.check_hand(
+        _hand_files(tmp_path, names), exec_fn=exec_fn,
+        grade_fn=grade_fn, expected=expected)[-1] == "HAND FAIL"
+    # A >1e-9 difference is not HAND OK either.
+    exec_fn, grade_fn, expected = _hand_fakes(exact=False)
+    assert cloud_exec.check_hand(
+        _hand_files(tmp_path, names), exec_fn=exec_fn,
+        grade_fn=grade_fn, expected=expected)[-1] == "HAND FAIL"
+    assert cloud_exec.hand_gate({"M1": "PASS"}, {}) is False  # no diffs
+    assert cloud_exec.hand_gate(
+        {n: "PASS" for n in cloud_exec.HAND_MUST_PASS
+         } | {n: "FAIL" for n in cloud_exec.HAND_MUST_FAIL},
+        {n: 0.0 for n in list(cloud_exec.HAND_MUST_PASS)
+         + list(cloud_exec.HAND_MUST_FAIL)}) is True
